Gold / Silver: After the eighth Johto badge, the eastbound route from New Bark leads into Route 27 and the League road.

Gold / Silver: Route 27 has a dedicated first-step scene: an NPC tells the player they have just entered Kanto.

Gold / Silver: Trainers, items, water/land paths, houses and Route 27's original optional content coexist with the main League path.

Gold / Silver: Tohjo Falls connects two sections of Route 27 and contains a Moon Stone item ball.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Main map `D45R0101` remains a traversal map; its field-script member is minimal because geometry/object data carries much of the behavior.

Gold / Silver: HM07 Waterfall + Rising Badge are required to negotiate the falls.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Waterfall remains the field-move progression mechanic.
Integration decision: Check semantic `MOVE_WATERFALL_USABLE` rather than hard-coding only the item slot; preserves future TM/HM architecture expansion.

Gold / Silver: Absent.

Gold / Silver: Absent.

Gold / Silver: Absent.

Gold / Silver: Not applicable.

Gold / Silver: Trainer-heavy climb toward the League includes a healing house and other route events.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Route 26 is remade with its route/building scripts and Gen IV field systems.
Integration decision: Preserve trainer order, healing services, houses, items and side NPCs; route progress is not just a level-gate.

Gold / Silver: Free healing is available before the Reception Gate.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Equivalent support remains in the remade route structure.

Gold / Silver: Gate also contains later routes toward Route 22/Mt. Silver as postgame states.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS adds separate `FLAG_UNLOCKED_WEST_KANTO` and `FLAG_UNLOCKED_MT_SILVER` state handling plus rematch/photo NPC logic.

Gold / Silver: Full cave map with items, pits/warps and encounter data precedes Indigo Plateau.

HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS rebuilds Victory Road into multiple DS map sections/floors with explicit fall-hole warps.
Integration decision: Preserve every source dungeon floor/object and convert puzzle topology separately from story triggers.

Gold / Silver: Rival confronts the player near the end of Victory Road before Indigo Plateau.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS `D43R0103` preserves the ambush and selects one of three rival trainer IDs from the player's starter choice.

Gold / Silver: Six-Pokémon team: Sneasel Lv34, Golbat Lv36, Magneton Lv35 (Lv34 in the Feraligatr branch), Haunter Lv35, Kadabra Lv35, final starter Lv38; moves are explicitly authored.

Gold / Silver: Pokémon Center, Mart and pre-Elite-Four support are available.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS lobby preserves nurse/shop services and expands UI/ranking/follower behavior.

Gold / Silver: Will → Koga → Bruno → Karen → Lance.

Gold / Silver: Ariados 40 / Venomoth 41 / Forretress 43 / Muk 42 / Crobat 44.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same species/levels first run.

Gold / Silver: Hitmontop 42 / Hitmonlee 42 / Hitmonchan 42 / Onix 43 / Machamp 46.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same species/levels first run.
Integration decision: Preserve base composition but keep source-specific move sets.

Gold / Silver: Umbreon 42 / Vileplume 42 / Gengar 45 / Murkrow 44 / Houndoom 47.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same species/levels first run.
Integration decision: Preserve composition and compare all move/item fields individually.

Gold / Silver: Gyarados 44 / Dragonite 47 / Dragonite 47 / Aerodactyl 46 / Charizard 46 / Dragonite 50.

Gold / Silver: Gen II trainer record has no per-Pokémon difficulty/ability/held-item model.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: First-run Lance has four Full Restores, AI flags=7, per-Pokémon difficulty=250; Aerodactyl forces its second ability; ace Dragonite Lv50 holds Sitrus Berry.
Integration decision: Trainer backport requires expanding trainer structs, not only copying party species and levels.

Gold / Silver: Champion defeat leads to Mary and Professor Oak arriving; Lance then guides player to Hall of Fame.
Crystal: Crystal preserves the same narrative skeleton.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS expands the choreography with Marill/follower handling, Mary/Oak actors and first-clear state changes before warping to Hall of Fame.

Gold / Silver: Hall of Fame sets `EVENT_BEAT_ELITE_FOUR`; later clears reuse the League system.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Champion/Hall of Fame scripts test `FLAG_GAME_CLEAR` and only perform certain world-unlock operations on the first clear.

Gold / Silver: Lance leads player to the machine; party is healed, Champion/party are registered, Elite Four completion flags are set and credits begin.
Crystal: Same code structure, with small text/localization differences.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS runs `HallOfFameAnim` using party count excluding Eggs and increments a League-win game statistic before credits.

Gold / Silver: If S.S. Ticket has not been received, Hall of Fame schedules Elm's special S.S. Ticket phone call.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS uses first-clear/player-house/Elm scene state rather than relying only on the old phone-call choreography.

Gold / Silver: Hall of Fame flips Olivine Port 'before/after Hall of Fame' event states and enables the postgame ship route.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS separately unhides Professor Oak at Olivine Port during the first Lance-clear flow.

Gold / Silver: After Elite Four clear, Elm gives S.S. Ticket and sets a dedicated received flag.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Elm Lab checks `FLAG_GAME_CLEAR`; if the ticket is not already owned it gives `ITEM_S_S__TICKET` and sets its received flag.

Gold / Silver: No separate National Dex unlock system.
Crystal: No separate National Dex unlock system.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: National Dex is enabled immediately before/around the first S.S. Aqua departure at Olivine Port.
Integration decision: Do not unlock Gen IV National Dex functions simply on badge 8; key them to the verified post-League Oak scene.

Gold / Silver: No HGSS mass-outbreak subsystem in this form.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Olivine Oak scene explicitly calls `EnableMassOutbreaks`.
Integration decision: Backport only after encounter-table/time/phone systems support the mechanic; track unlock independently from National Dex UI.

Gold / Silver: Requires post-League state and S.S. Ticket; Olivine port sets first-trip destination/state.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Port script rejects pre-clear/no-ticket states, sets boat direction and first-trip variables/flags when boarding.

Gold / Silver: A worried grandfather rushes past the player because his granddaughter is missing.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS preserves the missing-granddaughter sequence on the remade ship.

HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS rewrites the ship as multiple `P01R03xx` scripts around a numeric voyage-state variable and object flags.

Gold / Silver: The girl is found playing with the captain; returning her to her grandfather completes the first-voyage story.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS grandfather/cabin scripts explicitly track missing/found state and trigger arrival after the reunion.
Integration decision: One `SS_AQUA_GRANDDAUGHTER_FOUND` fact; save/reload at every stage must preserve actor placement.

Gold / Silver: First voyage ends in Vermilion City, establishing normal playable Kanto postgame.
